_doc: Hand-entered Mage effects (Forever). See hunter.manual.json for the format. 'frozen share' = fraction of your casts that land on a Frozen target: single-target leveling ~30% (Nova once per fight), AoE grinding ~50% (Nova -> Blizzard), raid 0% unless Fingers of Frost provides it.

Arcane Concentration.note: Clearcasting: 2%/rank chance per damaging spell that the next damage spell is free -> 10% of casts free at 5/5 = -10% mana on everything. (Parser mis-read the '100%' of the free cast.) Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 5.7% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 1.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x1.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (1.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Arcane Instability.note: +1%/rank damage with all spells and +1%/rank crit with all attacks (parser missed the crit clause). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 3.7% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 3.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (3.2%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, frost-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 4.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 4.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (4.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Arcane Subtlety.note: -8/rank target resistance to all spells ~= +0.5%/rank damage vs. resistant mobs; threat part ignored. 2026-09-27 audit: threat reduction on the mage's own school: 0.003/rank raid utility (the scorer does not read the threat channel; like Natural Grace, Suppression). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, fire-raid): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.1% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.00 to match (0.2%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): low, kite: -15 target resistances: fewer full resists of Frost Nova and Polymorph against Frost Resistance Aura/Totem and Mark of the Wild; damage part counted, threat part worthless in PvP.

Magic Absorption.note: +5/rank all resistances and mana on full resists: survivability against casters only. PvP (2026-09-27): low, resist: +10 all resistances: a few % more enemy Fears, Polymorphs and Frost Novas fully resisted, 2% mana back each time; the damage reduction is counted as survival.

Arcane Resilience.note: Armor from Intellect: 'further decrease your melee damage taken' while gathering packs -> +3% surv in leveling-aoe; nothing in raids.

Arcane Blast.note: New nuke that buffs OTHER spells by 10% per stack (4 stacks) at +175% mana per stack. Not modelled for Frost/Fire sources (an Arcane rotation model does not exist yet) -> 0. Listed so it is not treated as missing.

Arcane Shielding.note: Mana Shield efficiency and Mage Armor resistances: survivability. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: Mana Shield (a physical absorb on demand) drains 33% less mana per damage and Mage Armor gives 50% more resistances: a cheaper emergency absorb, a little CC resist vs casters.

Improved Counterspell.note: Beta text: 4s silence on Counterspell (the demo transcription read 2s): PvP/dungeon utility; a caster mob silenced for 4s per fight is worth ~1% while leveling. 2026-09-27 audit: the lab (which plays Counterspell on caster pulls) measures +0.1% +-0.5 against an expected +2.7%: 0.0005/rank, and it joins the lab's FIT list. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs -0.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Missile Barrage.note: 20% of Frostbolts/Fireballs make the next Arcane Missiles fast and free: an occasional free filler cast (~+1% damage, small mana saving). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-27, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, frost-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 0.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); mana values moved to the mana limit's unit (x0.30), raid values otherwise unchanged (noise) (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Presence of Mind.note: Instant nuke every 3 min: raid +1% (with Arcane Power); leveling: an instant Frostbolt opener on one pull in ~10 -> 1% utility. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 1.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 1.3% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (1.4%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, frost-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 0.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Arcane Power.note: +30% spell damage for 15s every 3 min = 8.3% uptime -> +2.5% average; costs 30% more mana during the window (-0.4% sustain). Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, frost-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 2.4% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.4%). Other modes unchanged.

Impact.note: Beta curve 3/7/10% stun chance per Fire spell hit: a 2s stun is ~2s of free casting on that fraction of Fire casts -> ~0.2% of Fire damage per 1% chance. Scoped to Fire sources so a Frost mage gets almost nothing. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, stun: Fire spells have a 10% chance to stun for 2 s: random stuns that open kill windows; Fire PvP only (a Frost build procs it only from Fire Blast).

Ignite.note: Fire crits burn for an extra 8%/rank of the spell's damage (40% at 5/5). A crit deals 150% -> the burn adds 0.4*1.5 = 60% of base on top of every crit = crit_bonus +0.12/rank on Fire sources. Raid stacking across mages is not modelled. Since 2026-09-26 the burn is the `ignite` damage source of the fire models (share from the simulators' split, rank-scaled): no multiplier here. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, fire-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 12.6% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 9.4% on the same scale); raid values scaled x64.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (9.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Pyroblast.note: 6s cast big nuke: a pre-pull opener while leveling (mob at range) = one strong hit per fight -> ~+3% fire damage; useless in a raid rotation without Hot Streak. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-25, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.4% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.22 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. Since 2026-09-26 Pyroblast is the `pyroblast` source (10% of the raid split, displacing Fireballs); this multiplier is the net gain over those Fireballs, re-fitted by the raid sim. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, fire-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 4.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 6.5% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.79 to match (4.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Scorch.note: Scorch applies +3% Fire damage taken per stack, 5 stacks, 33%/rank chance (100% at 3/3). Raid: kept at 5 stacks = +15% -> 5%/rank. Leveling: a mob dies before the stacks are worth the Scorches -> 1.5%/rank. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-25, levels 30,60): removing it costs 1.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 3.8% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.32 to match (1.1%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, fire-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 48.1% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 52.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (52.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Fire Ward.note: Reflect chance on Fire Ward: nothing measurable. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: Fire Ward reflects 20% of Fire spells back: a small defensive vs warlocks, fire mages and shamans.

Master of Elements.note: 10%/rank of base mana refunded on Fire/Frost crits: refund = 0.1r * crit chance. Leveling (8% crit): ~0.8%/rank; raid (25% crit): 2.5%/rank. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, fire-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 3.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 4.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (4.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Blast Wave.note: Instant AoE + daze every 45s: AoE grinding +10% fire/AoE damage and a snare; single target +1% (an instant while moving). Fight lab calibration (2026-09-25, levels 30,60): removing it costs -1.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.8% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.7%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, kite: Instant AoE with a 50% daze for 6 s (45 s cd): peels melee and restarts the kite; the damage is counted; Fire PvP only.

Combustion.note: Stacking +10% Fire crit per hit until 4 crits, every 3 min: ~+2% average raid damage; leveling ~+1%. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-25, levels 30,60): removing it costs 5.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.8% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x7.10 to match (5.2%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-10-03, ElliotWood/Forever b0f0df3, fire-raid, training dummy): removing it costs 3.9% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 6.4% on the same scale); raid values scaled x0.61 to match (3.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Frost Warding.note: Frost/Ice Armor +15%/rank armor and resistance: ~1% physical mitigation per rank; AoE: armor 'when getting mobs in the perfect Frost Nova position' -> +2%/rank surv in leveling-aoe. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: Frost Ward reflects 20% of Frost spells and effects back (frost mages, shamans); the Frost/Ice Armor armor part is counted as survival.

Permafrost.note: +33% chill duration and +9% slow at 3/3 (est. per rank). AoE loop enabler: 'of critical importance in order to make Improved Blizzard last enough for a second one to hit before the effect wears off' -> dmg Blizzard +8%/rank, surv +5%/rank in leveling-aoe (x0.6: the Forever chill is 1.5s x1.33 = 2s vs Classic 5s); single target kiting 0.6%/rank utility + 1%/rank surv. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 94.7% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 5.7% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x5.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (5.6%). Other modes unchanged.

Frostbite.note: 5%/rank chance per chill to freeze 5s. With Shatter 3/3 a freeze makes the next cast crit +51% (x1.5 damage on that cast): Frostbolt chills every cast -> 5%/rank of casts get a Shatter crit ~= +2.5%/rank frost damage... halved because Shatter is not guaranteed in the build -> 1.2%/rank. Also Ice Lance x3 on frozen. AoE: freezes inside Blizzard = extra Nova uptime (survival). Raid: 0 (bosses are immune to freezes). AoE grinding: 'Do NOT put points into this talent' - random freezes scatter the clump out of Blizzard: -6%/rank AoE damage, -3%/rank survivability in leveling-aoe. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 10.9% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 18.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (11.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Ice Lance.note: Instant, 300% vs Frozen. Single-target leveling: Nova -> 2 Ice Lances (instant, 4x damage each ~= 2 Frostbolts worth in 2 GCDs instead of 6s) -> ~+6% frost damage and less pushback. Raid: only with Fingers of Frost procs -> +2%. AoE: not used. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 15.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 21.1% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.57 to match (15.8%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Blizzard.note: Blizzard chill 15/30/45% (est., Classic 30/50/65%): 'the essential talent for this build' - Blizzard kills the pack while the snare keeps it off you. Enabler: dmg Blizzard +25%/rank, surv +10%/rank in leveling-aoe (x0.7 for the weaker chill); single target: a chilled runner, 1%/rank surv. PvP (2026-09-27): low, kite: Blizzard chills 40% for 1.5 s (2 s with Permafrost), each tick a chance at Frostbite/Fingers of Frost (unverified): battleground AoE control; rarely channeled in duels.

Arctic Reach.note: +10%/rank Frostbolt/Blizzard range and Nova/Cone radius: single target one more cast before melee (0.5%/rank); AoE 'hit enemies from further away, reducing your melee damage taken' and a bigger Nova/Cone catches stragglers -> dmg aoe +3%/rank, surv +4%/rank. 2026-09-27 audit: range is the one soft kind raid DPS counts: 0.002/rank raid utility. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, range: Frostbolt 36 yd, Frost Nova and Cone of Cold radius 12 yd: the root and slows catch targets further away.

Ice Block.note: 10s immunity every 5 min: removes most deaths on bad pulls (~4% effective health) plus an escape; AoE: pull-and-block gathering and the emergency button -> surv +15%, utility +2%. PvP (2026-09-27): high, defensive: 10 s immunity to all attacks and spells (5 min cd): waits out enemy burst and cooldowns; tier 4 in the beta, so Arcane- and Fire-heavy builds keep it.

Shatter.note: Beta curve +17/33/50% crit vs Frozen targets. Value = rank crit x share of casts on Frozen targets: single target ~30% (Nova once per fight); AoE grinding only the Nova's 8s before the run to range -> ~17% of Blizzard ticks (Icy Veins' AoE build skips Shatter entirely); raid 0 (bosses cannot be frozen). Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 12.6% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 37.7% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (24.5%). Other modes unchanged.

Fingers of Frost.note: Beta text: 15% of chills grant Fingers of Frost; rank 1 makes the next 1 spell count as Frozen, rank 2 the next 2 (the demo read 30%/1 at rank 2: same expected value). Only Shatter turns that into damage (+50% crit at 3/3): 0.15 x spells x 0.5 = +7.5%/rank crit on Frost casts in any mode (works on bosses). Requires Shatter 3/3 so the pair is valued together. Without Shatter only Ice Lance benefits (small). Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 22.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 29.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x3.37 to match (20.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Cold Snap.note: Resets Frost cooldowns every 10 min: a second Ice Block/Nova on a bad pull. AoE: 'a second shot at fixing a pull that is going wrong' -> surv +8%. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.2% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.1% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.1%). Other modes unchanged.

Winter's Chill.note: Beta text: 20%/rank chance per Frost spell to apply +2% Frostbolt/Ice Lance crit, stacking to 5 (the demo transcription said 1). At 5/5 five stacks are always up (+10% crit); lower ranks reach five stacks slowly and hold them (each proc refreshes the 15s window): ~2.5/3.75/4.5/5/5 average stacks. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs -2.2% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Other modes unchanged.

Ice Barrier.note: 447-damage shield (beta rank 1 at 60; higher ranks train later) every 30s, no pushback while it holds: ~8% effective health per fight while leveling and a large casting-uptime gain (+2% damage from no pushback); AoE: gather on the mount without being dazed off it and an escape when running -> surv +12%, utility +3% in leveling-aoe. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 41.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 16.5% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x5.00, the cap on effect size stops short of the target (16.3%). Other modes unchanged.

Improved Channeling.note: Pushback resistance for Arcane Missiles / Arcane Blast only: nothing for Frost/Fire models.

Arcane Geometry.note: +3 yd/rank Arcane range: nothing for Frost/Fire models. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, range: +6 yd on Arcane spells: Polymorph and Counterspell from 36 yd, outside most casters and healers (which spells count as Arcane is unverified).

Flame Throwing.note: +3 yd/rank Fire range: one extra cast before melee on some pulls (leveling only). 2026-09-27 audit: range: 0.002/rank raid utility. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, range: +6 yd on Fire spells (Fire Blast 26 yd, Scorch 36, Fireball/Pyroblast 41): Fire Blast from further while kiting, openers from out of range; Fire PvP only.

Burning Soul.note: 23%/rank chance to ignore pushback on Fire spells: while leveling you are hit during ~30% of casts, pushback costs ~0.5s each -> ~1%/rank casting time; threat part ignored. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-25, levels 30,60): removing it costs 1.6% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.5% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (2.2%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: threat reduction on the mage's own school: 0.003/rank raid utility (the scorer does not read the threat channel; like Natural Grace, Suppression). PvP (2026-09-27): medium, resist: 70% chance for Fire casts to ignore pushback from damage: Fireball and Pyroblast finish under melee pressure; the threat part is worthless in PvP; Fire PvP only.

Improved Frost Nova.note: -2s/rank Frost Nova cooldown (25s -> 21s). AoE loop (loops/mage.json frost-aoe): the cycle Nova 8s + run 2s + two 8s Blizzards + Cone is ~24s, so a 25s cooldown leaves the pack closing on you before the second Nova and a 21s one does not -> fewer melee hits (surv +10%/rank) and fewer cut Blizzards (+2%/rank Blizzard). Single target: a second Nova per multi-mob pull or runner (surv +3%/rank) plus the parsed cooldown cut on the Nova source. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.9% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.4% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x2.12 to match (0.9%). Other modes unchanged.

Elemental Precision.note: +1%/rank Frost/Fire hit (parsed). AoE grinding: 'you will need to avoid having even a single resist in a pack of 8+ enemies' - a resisted mob is a mob in melee -> +3%/rank surv in leveling-aoe. Fight lab calibration (2026-10-15, levels 40,60): removing it costs 7.3% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 5.1% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x1.72 to match (7.1%).
